system.description:
Range 30ft; one creature; Will negates (Disadvantage if you speak its true name). On a failure its body and soul are drawn into a gem worth 1,000 gp per HD of the target (the gem is not consumed) and held in suspended animation. It is freed when the gem is shattered, or when Dispel Magic cast on the gem succeeds against DC 18. A trapped soul cannot be raised or resurrected.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Wizard, Necromancer
